skill.name: fal-audio
skill.description: Guidance for planning text-to-speech and speech-to-text workflows with fal.ai audio models.
skill.summary: Plan fal.ai audio workflows for speech generation and transcription.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The two static network findings are documentation links to the upstream source repository. No executable code, prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, or suspicious instructions were found in SKILL.md.

finding_verdicts.reason: The URL is source metadata in SKILL.md front matter, not an executable network call. The prompt-only skill contains no code that fetches the URL or transmits data.
The URL is a Markdown reference to the upstream source repository. It is informational documentation and does not trigger network access or data exfiltration.

content.value_statement: Audio tasks need clear steps for generation, transcription, and review. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code plan fal.ai audio workflows.
actual_capabilities: Guides planning for fal.ai text-to-speech workflows.
Guides planning for fal.ai speech-to-text workflows.
Helps identify when fal.ai audio models fit an audio task.
Provides concise instructions for audio workflow design.
Links to the upstream source repository for additional context.
limitations: Does not include executable integration code or scripts.
Does not process audio files by itself.
Requires separate fal.ai account access and model configuration.
Does not provide current pricing, latency, or model availability details.

use_cases.title: Plan Voice Narration
use_cases.description: Create a structured text-to-speech plan for product videos, lessons, or support content.

use_cases.title: Prepare Audio Transcription
use_cases.description: Define inputs, expected outputs, and review steps for speech-to-text work using fal.ai models.

use_cases.title: Design Audio Features
use_cases.description: Outline app workflows that combine generated speech, transcription, and quality checks.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Transcription Task
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the fal-audio skill to plan a speech-to-text task. List the audio inputs, transcript output, and review checks.

prompt_templates.title: Create Narration Guidance
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the fal-audio skill to plan text-to-speech generation for a short product video. Include input preparation and quality checks.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Audio Workflow Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the fal-audio skill to compare speech generation and transcription paths for my application. Recommend the clearest workflow and constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Full Audio Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the fal-audio skill to design a workflow that transcribes recordings and creates spoken follow-up messages. Include validation and failure handling.

output_examples.input: Plan narration for a two-minute onboarding video.
output_examples.output: A short workflow covering script cleanup, voice selection, speech generation, listening review, and final export checks.

output_examples.input: Prepare speech-to-text for customer interview recordings.
output_examples.output: A transcription plan with audio preparation, expected transcript format, speaker review needs, and quality assurance steps.

output_examples.input: Design an app feature that replies to voice notes.
output_examples.output: A workflow that receives audio, transcribes speech, prepares a response, generates spoken audio, and verifies the result.

best_practices: Start with clear audio inputs and a defined output format.
Review generated speech or transcripts before sharing them with users.
Document model choices, voice settings, and quality checks for repeatable results.
anti_patterns: Do not assume the skill executes fal.ai API calls directly.
Do not process private audio without user consent and storage rules.
Do not publish generated speech or transcripts without human review.

faq.question: Does this skill generate audio directly?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance for planning fal.ai text-to-speech workflows.

faq.question: Can it help with transcription?
faq.answer: Yes. It helps plan speech-to-text workflows and review steps for transcripts.

faq.question: Does it require a fal.ai account?
faq.answer: You need separate fal.ai access to run actual model requests.

faq.question: Is executable code included?
faq.answer: No. The skill is prompt-only and contains no scripts or integration files.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should I verify before production use?
faq.answer: Verify privacy rules, model choice, audio quality, transcript accuracy, and operational costs.
